description: Runs external CLI agents (Agent Client Protocol) in the background and talks to them through the Chat view.
chatSessions.opencode.description: OpenCode agent running in the background (opencode acp)
chatSessions.opencode.welcomeMessage: Chat with OpenCode. It runs locally with your own opencode account and models.
chatSessions.opencode.inputPlaceholder: Ask OpenCode to build, fix or explain something
configuration.title: Nova Agents
configuration.opencode.args: Arguments passed to the OpenCode command to start its Agent Client Protocol server.
chatSessions.claudeCode.description: Claude Code running in the background (Agent Client Protocol adapter)
chatSessions.claudeCode.welcomeMessage: Chat with Claude Code. It uses your existing Claude Code sign-in.
chatSessions.claudeCode.inputPlaceholder: Ask Claude Code to build, fix or explain something
chatSessions.codex.description: OpenAI Codex CLI running in the background (Agent Client Protocol adapter)
chatSessions.codex.welcomeMessage: Chat with Codex. Sign in with ChatGPT or an OpenAI API key on first use.
chatSessions.codex.inputPlaceholder: Ask Codex to build, fix or explain something
chatSessions.gemini.description: Google Gemini CLI running in the background (--acp)
chatSessions.gemini.welcomeMessage: Chat with Gemini CLI. Sign in with Google or a Gemini API key on first use.
chatSessions.gemini.inputPlaceholder: Ask Gemini to build, fix or explain something
configuration.claudeCode.command: Command used to start the Claude Code ACP adapter.
configuration.claudeCode.args: Arguments for the Claude Code ACP adapter command.
configuration.codex.command: Command used to start the Codex ACP adapter.
configuration.codex.args: Arguments for the Codex ACP adapter command.
configuration.gemini.command: Command used to start Gemini CLI.
configuration.gemini.args: Arguments passed to Gemini CLI to start its Agent Client Protocol mode.
configuration.injectIdeManual: Send the Nova IDE manual (how to open files and images, use the integrated browser, and so on) to every agent at the start of each session, so it knows how to use the IDE.
chatSessions.nvidia.description: NVIDIA models (including free ones from build.nvidia.com) through OpenCode
chatSessions.nvidia.welcomeMessage: Chat with models hosted by NVIDIA. Many are free with a build.nvidia.com API key, which is asked on first use.
chatSessions.nvidia.inputPlaceholder: Ask a NVIDIA model to build, fix or explain something
chatSessions.openrouter.description: OpenRouter models (including free ones) through OpenCode
chatSessions.openrouter.welcomeMessage: Chat with any model on OpenRouter. Free models are listed by default; the API key is asked on first use.
chatSessions.openrouter.inputPlaceholder: Ask an OpenRouter model to build, fix or explain something
configuration.openrouter.freeModelsOnly: List only the free models of OpenRouter (ids ending in :free, or with zero price), instead of every model. Paid models use the credit of your OpenRouter account. Restart the OpenRouter chat after changing it.
